WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Finishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Finishing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Finishing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Finishing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Finishing.

2. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

6. When learning Orthographic Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

8. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.

9. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. CPU
   D. Keyboard

10. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Ignore burnt cables

11. When learning Manufactured boards, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Project activity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Detailed drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Trends in woodwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
